title: Portal Rendering Effect
difficulty_analysis: L5 challenges: (1) Calculating the portal camera transformation matrices for two RenderTargets—this involves coordinate-system transformations (inverse world-matrix transformations); (2) coordinating a pipeline that renders 3 times per frame (Portal 1 view + Portal 2 view + main view); (3) avoiding recursive rendering issues (hiding the portal surfaces while rendering portal views); (4) implementing a stencil-buffer mask; (5) synchronously scaling the frames and portal surfaces; (6) maintaining performance (3 render passes + high-resolution render targets).
